Lesson 14.15 · 10 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Consumer durable finance

After this lesson you can:
  • Run point-of-sale credit at retail speed with full controls
  • Reconcile merchant settlement, delivery and returns

1. The product

Checkout credit for appliances and electronics: the customer picks a product, pays a down payment, and the lender settles the verified merchant against the invoice — often inside minutes, at a point-of-sale counter or online. The contract facts are the transaction's skeleton: merchant, SKU, invoice, amounts, delivery-OTP confirmation, serial number.

Speed changes nothing regulatory: KFS, consent, KYC and cooling-off all fire inside those minutes, which is why this journey is a favourite stress test of 'instant but governed'.

2. What a BA watches

Returns and cancellations are the special mechanics: a returned television must unwind a live loan — merchant clawback, refund, schedule cancellation — cleanly. Merchant conduct (dark patterns at checkout, pushed add-ons) is channel governance from module 8 at its sharpest.

Knowledge check

1. A financed appliance is returned to the merchant. What must the platform do?

  1. Keep the loan running
  2. Unwind: merchant clawback, refund allocation, loan cancellation with clean accounting
  3. Convert to a personal loan
  4. Charge foreclosure fees
Show answer

B. Cancellation-and-refund with returns reconciliation is a designed lifecycle capability — retail credit lives and dies by clean unwinds.
